name: 頻度の範囲と自動区分の設定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source images have priority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, small controls and visible states. Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.
Official Lighthouse design: pure-white#FFFFFFpage/canvas; white surfaces; fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadow only where a real container exists. Forest-green brand#1F6444with smooth#174C36to#2D8F5Egradient on actual primary/selected controls. Supporting icons coherent slate#526173, no random decorative hues. Use only evidence-backed semantic accents. No broad mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Preserve Japanese Meiryo typography: headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, zero tracking; retain role-specific distinctions and normal-weight body. Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark. Apple Design: purpose, compact readable hierarchy, precise alignment, clear state and restrained material. This static raster does not prove interaction, editability or owner acceptance.
Input roles: Image1: original-source-primary-details; Image2: component-preview-secondary; Image3: approved-style-reference
One compact frequency-range setting, logical390x144. Purewhite background. Heading exact 頻度の区分, MeiryoBold20/28. Below one white rounded closed dropdown field with fine neutral outline12px corners; contains two lines: 4回から10回 then smaller gray 自動的に区分する, and single thin slate downward chevron aligned right center. Both lines are inside same dropdown as ORIGINAL summary groups range and automatic mode. Keep no separate auto link/button, no added option choices, no graphs, no background tint. BodyMeiryoRegular14/24, metadata12/16 zero tracking. Original source controls thin chevron geometry, optical stroke and white field anatomy; mock supplies Japanese words. Subtle shadow only beneath dropdown, tiny outer margins, no outer card, no decorative icon, no button. Preserve4and10 exactly.
Evidence-based accent decision: No selected or status accent needed on closed range field. White neutral border and slate chevron/text; no mint fill. Automatic mode is descriptor within same control not invented separate action.
reviewNotes: 原画の範囲4〜10と自動区分を同一ドロップダウンへ復元。日本語を保持しミント面を白へ。出力実見済み。下向きシェブロンが原画より太く大きく、見出し光学重量も強いため要修正。操作・所有者承認・編集可能性は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
